description: This file defines the IncomingMessageInterstitial activity class, which provides a user interface for switching to an app in response to incoming messages, including handling button click events and constructing activity stacks.

classes.name: IncomingMessageInterstitial
classes.description: An activity that provides an interstitial UI for notifications related to IncomingMessage.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and sets up the button click listener.

methods.name: switchToApp
methods.description: Builds and launches an intent stack to switch to the main application activity and finalizes the current activity.
